subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After a final rebase and exact-head validation, should this grouped executable-action refresh land together or should the secret-bearing Codex, token, and registry action updates be reviewed separately?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but accepting grouped third-party executable changes across privileged workflows is a repository risk choice that the protected security label reserves for human review.

options.title: Validate and merge the batch
options.body: Keep the focused Dependabot batch together and merge only after the final SHA passes the relevant workflow, release, and security checks.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, Docker-login, labeler, and stale updates for narrower provenance review and rollback.

options.title: Pause this refresh
options.body: Close or defer the batch if Dependabot cannot produce a stable rebased head with attributable green validation.

recommendation.title: Validate and merge the batch
recommendation.body: Keep the focused Dependabot batch together and merge only after the final SHA passes the relevant workflow, release, and security checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The workflow history and live timeline provide the strongest available signal connecting this person to the central CI, release, and Codex automation surfaces.
